title: Hydroxycitrate: A Novel Therapy for Calcium Phosphate Urinary Stones
official: Hydroxycitrate: A Novel Therapy for Calcium Phosphate Urinary Stones
summary: This study tests whether hydroxycitrate, a molecule closely related to citrate, can reduce calcium phosphate stone recurrence.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Calcium Phosphate stone formers

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of recurrent urinary tract infections
* Chronic diarrhea
* Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) \< 45 ml/min/1.73 m2
* History of primary hyperparathyroidism
* Hypokalemia
* Hyperkalemia
* Pregnancy
sponsor: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center
